weeks.title: Week 1: Core Fundamentals & Concept Mastery
objectives: Understand syntax, core paradigms, and internal workings of Responsive Design, Node.js.
Set up local development environment, tooling, and run first working demos.
Complete fundamental exercises and documentation tutorials.

tasks.text: Read official documentation and setup guides for Responsive Design
Solve 10 practice coding exercises covering core data structures and syntax
Build a minimalist CLI or starter prototype applying the fundamental concepts

weeks.projectMilestone: Console or Starter Prototype implementing Responsive Design + Node.js basics.

weeks.title: Week 2: Hands-on Building & Real-World Integration
objectives: Master intermediate to advanced features of Express.js, RESTful APIs.
Integrate APIs, state/data management, and persistent storage.
Implement robust error handling and modular design patterns.

tasks.text: Implement asynchronous workflows, REST APIs, or data models
Connect application components and handle edge cases gracefully
Commit all progress to GitHub with clear atomic commit messages

weeks.projectMilestone: Build an API Gateway with Route Handlers and Input Validation

weeks.title: Week 3: Code Quality, Testing & Deployment
objectives: Write unit and integration tests to ensure reliable code.
Refactor code following Clean Code principles and design patterns.
Containerize application with Docker and set up automated CI pipeline.

tasks.text: Write automated unit tests for core business logic functions
Benchmark and optimize execution speed / API latency
Deploy the application to cloud hosting (Render / Vercel / Railway)

weeks.projectMilestone: Deployed Cloud Application with automated GitHub CI build checks.

weeks.title: Week 4: Capstone Project & Technical Interview Mastery
objectives: Complete a standout Capstone project highlighting Responsive Design, Node.js, Express.js, RESTful APIs.
Prepare comprehensive technical interview answers and live coding practice.
Update resume and LinkedIn profile with demonstrable project links.

tasks.text: Write comprehensive README with architecture diagram, live demo link, and setup guide
Complete 20 interview MCQs & coding challenges on Full Stack Web Developer
Conduct a peer mock interview and refine explanations of your architectural choices

weeks.projectMilestone: Production-grade Portfolio Showcase Project ready for Full Stack Web Developer job applications.
